findings: dataset_create_new ignores convert_to_csv in its serialized request; the relevant assignment is commented out.
dataset_create_new wraps final create_dataset in with_retry whose default is10 attempts for retryable HTTP errors. High-level create is not a one-shot mutation.
Its initial dataset_status guard treats every HTTPError as absence, so independent authoritative identity/absence checks are necessary.
dir_mode=zip generates a separate zip per top-level directory with the directory contents at its archive root; do not assume server archive-name wrapper restoration.
ListDatasetFiles and DownloadDataset requests accept explicit dataset_version_number from owner/slug/1, allowing exact versioned read-only reconciliation.

recommendation.mutation: Avoid the SDK final with_retry wrapper for publication; use a guarded one-shot exact request or explicitly disable retries at all relevant mutation layers, then reconcile read-only.
recommendation.structure: One explicit ZIP of the complete prepared bundle with logical relative paths retained together. Keep only dataset-metadata.json plus that ZIP in the new upload directory; use no implicit directory packing. The existing loader locates the exact bound bundle manifest recursively and resolves code/encoder paths relative to its parent, tolerating any single outer archive wrapper.
recommendation.uncertain_create: Record intent and exact logical per-file hashes before a single final create request. After uncertainty, never retry create automatically: query same owner/slug, require private and currentVersionNumber1, record datasetID, wait read-only for processing completion, enumerate all version1 files with bounded pagination, and stream-download version1 payloads to verify every expected logical path/size/SHA with no extras. Verify raw payload bytes, not just remote sizes or server-generated download-ZIP SHA. Account for download transport ZIP wrappers by validating contained member bytes. Recheck privateID/currentVersion1 after reads. Missing/403/processing/ambiguous/mismatch stays blocked, not safe-to-retry.

scope_limits: Synthetic temporary archives only; no real checkpoint archive, upload or server path semantics were executed.
Official documentation says uploaded archives are decompressed with their directory structure preserved; per-directory archive basename wrapping is not assumed.
